snippet.title: Random Dinner Budget $7
snippet.description:
Random Dinner Budget 6 ($7): Ground Chicken And Vegi Rice A Roni 

These recipes are a guideline to make any budget work! For example, you can use pork instead of chicken, whichever Rice-A-Roni flavor you prefer, and any veggie, popular ones being broccoli and corn. Feel free to remove, swap, or add whatever you like!

Inspiration: @KingKev

⏰ Prep: 3 minutes| 🍳 Cook: 20 minutes

🍚 Serves: 3

🍴 Ingredients

* 1 lb ground chicken
* 1 box Rice-A-Roni (Mexican or Cheddar Broccoli)
* 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables
* Water, as called for on the box
* Tony Chachere’s or your favorite seasoning (optional)

👩‍🍳 Steps

1️⃣ Cook the veggies
Add the frozen vegetables to a hot pan with a little oil. Cook for about 2 minutes until defrosted and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.

2️⃣ Brown the chicken
Add the ground chicken and let it sit for 2 minutes without stirring. Flip, let it cook another 2 minutes, then break it up and cook through.

3️⃣ Season
Add the Rice A Roni seasoning packet or your favorite seasonings. Adjust to taste.

4️⃣ Toast the rice
Add the rice to the chicken and toast for 1–2 minutes.

5️⃣ Add water
Pour in the amount of water listed on the box. Bring to a simmer and cover.

6️⃣ Add the veggies
Stir the vegetables back in when there’s about 5 minutes of cooking time left.

7️⃣ Rest
Turn off the heat and leave covered for 3 minutes so the rice can finish absorbing the moisture.

8️⃣ Serve
Give everything a stir, taste, adjust the seasoning, and enjoy!

snippet.title: POV: A Virus Helped Build the Placenta
snippet.description:
Sources- PMID 22695103 
Vanessa Vasconcelos on TT 

Millions of years ago, an ancient retrovirus infected the ancestors of early mammals and permanently inserted its genetic code into their DNA. Normally, viruses use specialized surface proteins to fuse with host cells so they can enter and multiply. Instead of remaining harmful, this viral gene was eventually tamed and repurposed by the host's body, becoming a vital blueprint known as syncytin. Today, this borrowed viral gene is essential for human pregnancy because it instructs cells in the developing placenta to fuse together into a single, continuous barrier. This specialized layer allows oxygen and nutrients to pass smoothly from the mother to the baby while simultaneously shielding the fetus from the mother's immune system. Without that ancient viral infection, the complex mammalian placenta as we know it likely would not exist. 

#placenta #pregnancy #art
